# Gurrulabs

> Independent one-person Android app studio. Apps: Pulse (reaction time and timing game), Raffy (baby tracker), Cyberpunk Detective (detective mysteries), Lull (tinnitus sleep sounds, not on Google Play yet).

## Studio

- [Gurrulabs](https://gurrulabs.pages.dev/en/): Studio home: the four apps and where to get each one.

## Pulse

- [Pulse](https://gurrulabs.pages.dev/en/pulse/): Android game with 5 modes: Exact Time, Hidden Clock, Interval, Reaction, Batak. No account, works offline. Includes a browser version of two modes.
- [Reaction time test](https://gurrulabs.pages.dev/en/pulse/reaction-time-test/): Browser reaction time test: tap when the lights go out; the result is in seconds (perfect up to 0.30 s, pass under 0.40 s).
- [3 second challenge](https://gurrulabs.pages.dev/en/pulse/3-second-challenge/): Browser game: stop a stopwatch at exactly 3.00 s (pass window ±0.10 s).
- [Average reaction time by age](https://gurrulabs.pages.dev/en/pulse/average-reaction-time-by-age/): Guide: average simple reaction time by age group, 18 to 65 (Woods et al. 2015, Table 2), what changes it, with sources.
- [Pulse on Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.gurrulabs.pulse): Android download page.

## Other apps

- [Raffy](https://raffyparenting.com/): baby tracker for feeds, sleep and growth, with WHO charts.
- [Cyberpunk Detective](https://gurrulabs.pages.dev/en/cyberpunk-detective/): Free Android game on Google Play (ads, no in-app purchases, no account) mixing 3 detective cases you solve and 3 audio crime stories you listen to; cases work offline; game text in English, Spanish and French.
- [Lull](https://gurrulabs.pages.dev/en/lull/): Coming-soon Android wellness app (not a medical device) with sleep sounds tuned to your pitch and a 15-second daily check-in for people with tinnitus. Not on Google Play yet; email sign-up.
- [Cyberpunk Detective on Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.gurrulabs.miniaicrimes): Android download page.
